description: This file contains utility functions and checks for tensor list operations in PyTorch's ATen library, including validation of tensor properties, device and dtype consistency, and fast path eligibility for tensor operations.

methods.name: has_integral_tensor
methods.description: Checks if a list of tensors contains either an integral or boolean tensor based on includeBool flag.

methods.name: has_bool_tensor
methods.description: Checks if a list of tensors contains any boolean tensor.

methods.name: check_foreach_api_restrictions
methods.description: Validates tensor list constraints for foreach API, including non-emptiness and size consistency.

methods.name: check_fast_path_restrictions
methods.description: Verifies if tensor lists meet criteria for fast path execution, including device, dtype, size, and layout consistency.

methods.name: convert_tensor_to_scalar_list
methods.description: Converts a tensor of scalars into a vector of c10::Scalar, ensuring it is on CPU, contiguous, and 1D.

methods.name: can_use_fast_route
methods.description: Determines if tensor lists can utilize the fast execution path based on restrictions.

methods.name: _group_tensors_by_first_tensors_device_and_dtype
methods.description: Groups nested tensor lists by device and dtype, optionally including indices.

search-terms: group tensors by device and dtype
